knownLimitations: The extended 600.9-second session passed in the earlier full UAT run; it was intentionally not repeated in the final quick rerun.
Touch was emulated; physical touch and pinch hardware were unavailable.
SwiftShader was used; physical GPU performance and memory were not measured.
WebGL context-loss injection, forced storage quota exhaustion, interrupted writes, and browser zoom extremes were not tested.
No separate integration test suite is configured.
